pomoch.metaDescription: Record phrases · check lessons · share words — t.bur.mn
pomoch.title: Looking for Buryat language experts
pomoch.headline: Буряад хэлэн — хэлэмнай!
pomoch.bannerText: Looking for Buryat language experts — help with your voice and by checking lessons
pomoch.posterAlt: Looking for Buryat language experts — t.bur.mn
pomoch.why: We are building a free app for learning the Buryat language. We don't ask for money — we ask for your voice and your knowledge of the language. Without experts the lessons won't have a voice and won't be accurate.
post: We are building a free app for learning the Buryat language: lessons, voice recordings, a dictionary and a translator.
We don't ask for money — we ask for your voice and your knowledge of the language:
All helpers go on the wall of honor 🏆
Write in the comments or send a message, and we will give you access to the studio.
pomoch.aboutIntro: t.bur.mn is a free website about the Buryat language. The goal is simple: to make Buryat possible to learn, hear and use every day.
works: Buryat-Russian and Russian-Buryat dictionary with tens of thousands of words
Explainer — breaks down a Buryat phrase: what a word consists of, which case it is in, why the word order is what it is
Buryat keyboard with ү, ө, һ right on the site
doing: A lesson course from the alphabet to fluent speech — more than 1000 lessons
Live voice recordings — every phrase read by a native speaker
Studio for experts — checking and recording card by card, wall of honor
help: Record phrases from the lessons with your voice — about 10 minutes a day
Check lessons by swipe: correct or mistake
pomoch.helpNote: All you need is a phone or a computer. Even 10 minutes a day helps.
